stress_gate_review.interpretation_limit: This is a bounded pilot screening criterion, not proof of equilibrium and not publication-grade simultaneous inference. A CI spanning zero is absence of resolved drift under this test, not proof of zero drift.
stress_gate_review.joint_liquid_qa_wiring: Confirmed: pressure/stress gate is included in the joint liquid pass condition; missing or malformed inputs produce QA_HOLD and insufficient data produce PENDING, never default PASS.
stress_gate_review.method: OLS trend with residual circular moving-block bootstrap; tau_int estimated from detrended residuals using the initial-positive sequence; block length ceil(2*tau_int/dt); 2000 deterministic replicates.
stress_gate_review.minimum_data_rule: At least 4.0 ps at 0.01 ps cadence and at least 8 complete autocorrelation-sized blocks are required for this pilot gate. Any insufficient series remains PENDING and cannot pass. At 400 samples, the eight-block rule requires an estimated block length no greater than 50 samples; longer correlation requires more data.
stress_gate_review.multiple_comparison_policy: No adjustment across pressure and six components is accepted for this conservative fail-closed screen. Intervals are per-series nominal 95%, not simultaneous 95% intervals. Under independent all-null series, the chance of at least one false drift flag could reach 1-(0.95)^7=30.2%; actual dependence is unknown. This primarily raises false HOLD/extra-sampling risk; it is not grounds to claim a familywise 95% guarantee.
stress_gate_review.resolved_drift_rule: A two-sided 95% bootstrap slope interval excluding zero is a resolved drift; any resolved pressure or stress-component drift fails this subgate.
